os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=min(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    # Fill enclosed non-boundary components, using the dominant background and boundary color.
    from collections import deque
    colors=set(v for row in g for v in row)
    boundary=max(colors-{bg}, key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if g[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False
        while q:
          y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x)); edge |= y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==bg:
              seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
        if not edge:
          for y,x in comp:g[y][x]=4
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
